question: Mira is the wife of Ketan. Chaitanya is the brother of Kapila, who is the wife of Sudeep. Rani is the mother of Ketan and the wife of Surendra. Chaitanya is the son of Rani. How is Surendra related to Sudeep?
solution: Family chart : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b1f34d9d345d28958acae0d38b78ab3e7761ac92b72485fda5c2625e907bdf8.png] 1) Mira is the wife of Ketan. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4eb65fe48216a1a8be27e00c0e943fb9ebb3206f28e94138155e277859cc3b0.png] 2) Rani is the mother of Ketan and the wife of Surendra.
